desc:
🚗🥚 Welcome to Drive to Steal Eggs!

Floor it down the runway, grab the eggs and race back before the giant boss animals catch you!

How to Play:
🚗 Drive your car down the runway and grab eggs from the nests
🦖 Escape the boss animal that wakes up and chases you
🐣 Bring the egg home and hatch it in your base
💰 Earn money from every animal in your base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to get FASTER
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill, your pen and your car
🌍 Drive further to reach new stages with rarer animals
💥 Smash through trees, rocks and crystals on the way!
📖 Collect every animal in the Pet Index for rewards
✨ Hunt for rare sizes and mutations: Gold, Diamond, Ruby, Emerald... even GODZILLA size!
🦄 Open the Fantasy Egg for legendary creatures you can't find anywhere else

🎮 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet and Console!
👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to get notified about new updates!
